Container.Name: CustomMinecraftServer
Container.Overview:
Run ANY Minecraft server (Vanilla, Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, Paper, Spigot, FTB, modpacks) from a directory you already have. Mount your pre-downloaded server folder to /serverdata/serverfiles and the container installs the correct Java (Temurin) runtime, accepts the EULA, and launches it.
TWO LAUNCH MODES:
1) GENERIC LAUNCHER (default - leave 'Start Server Script' empty): auto-detects Forge/NeoForge (libraries/.../unix_args.txt), Fabric (fabric-server-launch.jar), or a vanilla/Paper jar and launches it headless. If a Forge/NeoForge server is not installed yet, it runs a bundled forge-*-installer.jar, or downloads and installs one when you set MC Version + Forge Version (or NeoForge Version). Memory/JVM flags come from XMX/XMS/Extra JVM Parameters - a pack's own user_jvm_args.txt is ignored so RAM lives in one place.
2) PER-PACK OVERRIDE (set 'Start Server Script' to the name, without .sh, of a script inside the server dir): runs that pack's own launcher verbatim, with the installed Java on PATH.
WEB CONSOLE / ADMIN INPUT: open HOSTIP:9011 (eg 192.168.1.1:9011) or click WebUI. It attaches to the live server console with input enabled, so you can type server commands AND answer any interactive prompts a pack's start script shows (interactive scripts will otherwise wait for input).
JAVA RUNTIME: pick with 'Runtime Name' - basicjre=Java 8, jre11, jre16, jre17, jre21, or jre<N> for any major version Adoptium publishes. Switching versions automatically removes the old runtime.
ATTENTION: You must set 'Accept EULA' to true to start the server (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA). Remove client-only mods (eg rubidium) from a pack's mods folder - they crash dedicated servers.

Config.Name: Server Files
Config.Description: Your pre-downloaded server/modpack directory. The runtime, installed libraries and world are written here.

Config.Name: Start Server Script
Config.Description: OVERRIDE: name (without .sh) of a start script inside the server dir to run. Leave EMPTY to use the built-in generic auto-detect launcher (recommended).

Config.Name: Runtime Name
Config.Description: Temurin JRE to install: basicjre=Java 8, jre11, jre16, jre17, jre21, or jre<N>. Switching versions auto-removes the old runtime. Forge/NeoForge 1.20.1 needs jre17; 1.21+ needs jre21.

Config.Name: Accept EULA
Config.Description: Read the Minecraft EULA at https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA. Set to 'true' to accept and allow the server to start.

Config.Name: XMX Size (MB)
Config.Description: Maximum Java heap size in MB. For large modpacks 4096-8192 is typical.

Config.Name: XMS Size (MB)
Config.Description: Initial/minimum Java heap size in MB. Usually set equal to XMX.

Config.Name: MC Version
Config.Description: Minecraft version (eg 1.20.1). Only needed so the generic launcher can DOWNLOAD+install Forge when the dir has no installer/libraries. Pair with Forge Version.

Config.Name: Forge Version
Config.Description: Forge version (eg 47.4.8) for the generic launcher's download-install. Requires MC Version.

Config.Name: NeoForge Version
Config.Description: NeoForge version (eg 21.1.72) for the generic launcher's download-install (alternative to Forge).

Config.Name: Extra JVM Parameters
Config.Description: Extra JVM flags (eg Aikar's GC flags). Applied by the generic launcher. Leave blank if unsure.

Config.Name: Extra Game Parameters
Config.Description: Extra arguments passed to the server after 'nogui'. Leave blank if not needed.

Config.Name: Serverfile name
Config.Description: For the vanilla/Paper path: the server jar filename without .jar. Ignored for Forge/NeoForge/Fabric detection.

Config.Name: Game version (vanilla)
Config.Description: Vanilla auto-download: 'latest' downloads the newest Vanilla server (JAR_NAME must be 'server'), 'custom' uses your own jar, or leave empty. Not used for modpacks.

Config.Name: Custom JVM Command
Config.Description: Advanced: fully override the JVM invocation. Bypasses the generic launcher. Leave blank unless you know you need it.

Config.Name: Enable Web Console
Config.Description: Serve the browser console (gotty) on port 8080, with input enabled for admin commands and answering prompts.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone (eg America/Denver) so Auto Restart Time is interpreted as local time. The container is UTC without this.

Config.Name: Auto Restart Time
Config.Description: Optional daily restart at this HH:MM (24h, container timezone - set Timezone too). Warns players in-game, stops the server, and Docker restarts a fresh container. Leave EMPTY to disable.

Config.Name: Auto Restart Warnings
Config.Description: Comma-separated minutes-before-restart to broadcast an in-game warning. Only used when Auto Restart Time is set.

Config.Name: TCP - Game Port
Config.Description: Minecraft game port.

Config.Name: TCP - RCON
Config.Description: RCON port (optional; only if enabled in server.properties).

Config.Name: TCP - Web Console
Config.Description: Browser console (gotty). Connect at HOSTIP:9011 by default.

Config.Name: UID
Config.Description: User Identifier for file ownership.

Config.Name: GID
Config.Description: Group Identifier for file ownership.
